title: with_total(0) makes is_complete() return true before any parts added, inconsistent with reassemble()
description: PartCollection::with_total(0) creates a collection where missing_parts() returns [] (1..=0 is empty) and is_complete() returns true immediately — before any parts are inserted. When the caller then calls reassemble(), it returns Err(MultiUuError::EmptyCollection). This is an API coherence failure: is_complete() says 'yes, go ahead' but reassemble() says 'nothing to do'. The lib.rs end-to-end example (line 84-88) extracts part_total from the subject and calls PartCollection::with_total(total) without checking for zero first. A subject like 'file.bin (3/0)' produces part_total=Some(0), which the example code passes directly to with_total(), silently creating a permanently-complete-but-empty collection. The parse_subject docs warn about this at line 107-110 but the warning is not at the call site and the API provides no guard.
